red_evidence: evidence/IJNANO/N05AR/red_run.txt (final test suite executed against pre-repair implementation in a detached worktree at f62ddc2; 31 of 45 tests red, 14 anchors green)

defects.concern: Incomplete state predicates: state_interpretation used zip(got, want) positional matching, detected excess predicates but not missing required predicates; duplicates and contradictions misattributed; valid predicates in a different order wrongly rejected
defects.root_cause: positional zip comparison with only a len(got)>len(want) excess check; no (entity, property) identity keying
defects.repair: identity-keyed matching contract in eval_state_interpretation: MISSING_PREDICATE for unclaimed required identities (suppressed when a wrong-entity claim targets the same property, reported as ENTITY_MISMATCH substitution); DUPLICATE_PREDICATE for a second claim on one identity (incl. eq/ne contradictions); EXTRA_ASSERTION for out-of-scope or redundant extra claims; order-independent

defects.concern: Undeclared action arguments: action_representation checked expected slots but ignored unexpected keys in response.args; no optional-argument contract; duplicate keys in raw structured output undetected
defects.root_cause: undeclared-argument check existed only in the slot_value family and only for the extra_assertions channel populated by an upstream parser; action_representation had no response.args key-set validation and no raw structural gate
defects.repair: ARGUMENT_UNDECLARED emitted from response.args alone in both action_representation and slot_value; SlotSpec.optional declares permitted optional arguments (checked when supplied, omittable); strict raw-JSON gate (_raw_reasons) rejects duplicate object keys with PARSE_INVALID before family evaluation

defects.concern: Predicate semantics: predicate_holds conflated expression equivalence with truth against observed state, compared one predicate's threshold against another threshold as if observed, and raised TypeError on non-numeric values under ordering operators
defects.root_cause: single predicate_holds function with no world-state channel; no type guard before applying Python comparison operators
defects.repair: split into predicates_equivalent(claimed, expected) - explicit exact-equivalence contract (same identity+operator+unit-aware threshold equality; no cross-operator rewriting such as ge 5 == gt 4) - and predicate_truth(pred, world) - truth against an independently supplied (entity, property)->observation world with unit conversion, boundary-exact ordering semantics, and TYPE_MISMATCH on invalid types instead of a crash; 12 TRUTH_CONTROLS cover eq/ne/gt/ge/lt/le boundaries, units, invalid types, unknown identities
new_controls: TRUTH_CONTROLS (12) incl. truth.fliptrap_le for inequality-flip mutants

defects.concern: Identifier collisions: canonical_label folding (case, whitespace, underscore/space) was applied to every identifier class, merging distinct tool ids (adjust_stock vs adjust stock), distinct entity ids (ORD-1042 vs ord-1042), and masking case-sensitivity requirements
defects.root_cause: blanket canonical folding across all comparison sites
defects.repair: identifier_matches(actual, expected, kind, aliases) with kind-scoped rules: 'label' (closed natural-language vocabularies: intent, goal types, enum values, branches, recovery actions, decisions, clarification topics) keeps folding; 'tool'/'entity'/'action' use exact identity unless an explicit alias contract declares accepted variants (matched exactly); leading zeros and Unicode variants never fold; the v1 folded-entity and folded-tool positives became collision negatives
behavior_changes: action.pos.alt_repr no longer folds tool/entity case

defects.concern: Missing unit handling: a scalar quantity silently inherited the hidden expected unit via check_slot; no distinction between publicly declared units and hidden expectations
defects.root_cause: check_slot defaulted unit = slot.unit for any scalar response value
defects.repair: SlotSpec.unit_publicly_declared records that the unit is part of the public task/schema contract; only then may a bare scalar (or a dict without a unit key) inherit it; otherwise UNIT_MISSING; non-finite values and numeric strings remain TYPE_MISMATCH (no silent coercion)

defects.concern: Mutation testing weakness: the v1 suite only removed reason codes after evaluation (post-hoc drops); no comparator-level mutants
defects.root_cause: no mutant harness over the comparator implementation itself
defects.repair: apply_mutant/clear_mutant swap real comparator functions/handlers (_OPS, check_quantity, check_slot, identifier_matches, _raw_reasons, family handlers; evaluate_family resolves handlers through module globals at call time so swaps take effect); nine mutant classes implemented; qualification.mutation_gate runs the full gate (battery + predicate-truth controls) against each; all nine detected with named witnesses; retained v1 rule-drop mutants re-verified against the v2 rule set (19/19 load-bearing)

defects.concern: Coverage reconciliation: contract declared 16 reason codes while controls exercised 14 (PARSE_INVALID and ARGUMENT_MISMATCH untested); malformed evaluator inputs (empty expectations, unregistered units, duplicate battery ids) were silently accepted
defects.root_cause: no construction-time validation and no declared/reachable/tested reconciliation record
defects.repair: contract v2: REASON_CODES (19) reconciled with controls via qualification.reason_coverage; ARGUMENT_MISMATCH declared obsolete with explicit disposition (subsumed by MISSING_SLOT/ARGUMENT_UNDECLARED/VALUE_MISMATCH/ENTITY_MISMATCH/TYPE_MISMATCH/UNIT_MISMATCH/UNIT_MISSING); Expectation/Quantity/SlotSpec/StatePredicate validate at construction; qualification.validate_control_battery rejects malformed batteries; qualification.qualify_family_scope enforces the per-N03-family dataset rules (positive witness, critical negatives, semantic mutations, alternative responses where applicable, versioned evaluator scope identity)
